title: 第25章  巨龙复仇危级事件第26章  人人皆能如龙象
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
铁牛瘦了，也老了。
他本来长得就显老，只是气质稍显稚嫩，给人的感官就有些怪异不协调。
这下好了，气质也变老了，里外里熟透了。
一次修行过来，浑身气质陡然一变，铁血坚硬，恍惚间让他娘王巧兰，以为他那当边防军的爹死而复生。
想到这些年单亲带娃的不易，鼻子一酸，当场就哭成泪人，把铁牛慌的好一阵哄。
而相比于铁牛，苏青的变化更为明显。
原先瘦弱的身体，现在变得精壮有力。
气质也更加自信昂扬，顾盼生辉，像初生的太阳，神采照人，只是站在那里，都有股摄人心魄的压迫感。
这是修为突破的正常变化，即便他在父母面前稍有收敛，也还是让苏老实跟王慧兰有些陌生。
苏老实从他肩膀，拍到胸口，再比了比身高，最后才满足道：
“这感觉，快跟你二伯差不多了！”
“跟二伯还差的远，他都是D级武者了，我才只是个E。”苏青自谦道。
“那是，你二伯这么多年摸爬滚打，你现在跟他还比不了，你这年纪有E就不错了，不对，你说什么，儿子你是E级武者了？”
苏老实声音颤抖，眼睛发直，有些不敢相信。
这些天，他也经常搜索武道圣胎的相关信息。
知道那里是武道修行的圣地。
每个武者跟创武师，都能在那里获得长足进步。
可没想到，自己儿子进步这么大！
这就是E了？
“是E级武者，那元气是不是补回来了，寿数是不是提升了？”

王慧兰急切问道，别人关注武者等级只关注实力强不强，地位高不高。
而作为母亲，尤其是为儿子短寿问题操心多年的她，只关心儿子活的长不长。
“补回来了，再活七八十年没问题！”苏青明白她的担心，抱了抱她，轻声宽慰道。
“不止七八十年，你还能创武，还能练武，以后活百年，千年都没问题！”
苏老实摸了摸眼眶，笑呵呵的道。
苏青知道武者想活过百年不难，但想寿数继续提升就不容易了。
据他所知，天蓝星迄今没有千岁老人的记录，目前最老的武圣，也就八百来岁而已。
但他对苏老实之言，也只是微微一笑，没有反驳。
而跟家人们分享了番在武道圣胎里的修行经历后。
刚才还拿他当宝的苏老实跟王慧兰，又埋怨他太不把铁牛当人。
倒是三姨王巧兰拎得清，虽然也心疼儿子，但有过丧夫之痛的她更清楚。
武道圣胎里练不死人，在现实世界没有真本事，才真的会出事。
“不打不成器，不练不成材。
铁牛的悟性我知道，当年能进第一高中，还是姐夫托关系进去的。
要不是小青，连武院都上不了，更别说成为E级武者了！”
王巧兰跟苏老实夫妇说着话，又叮嘱铁牛日后好好跟着苏青。
这话铁牛都听出老茧了，但也仍然耐心听着，点头应是。
说完他们在武道圣胎里的经历。
苏老实又絮絮叨叨的跟二人说了说现实情况。
苏青边听着他说，边拿起手机上网搜着新闻。

这在武道圣胎的日子，完全跟现实社会脱节。
content_en:
Tieniu has become thinner and older.
He already looks old, but his temperament is a little childish, which makes him feel a little weird and uncoordinated.
It's better now, her temperament has become older, and she's become more mature inside and out.
After a training session, his temperament suddenly changed, becoming iron-blooded and hard. For a moment, his mother, Wang Qiaolan, thought that his father, a border guard, had come back from the dead.
Thinking about how difficult it has been for a single parent to raise a child these years, my nose felt sour, and I burst into tears on the spot, which made Tieniu panic for a while.
Compared to Tieniu, Su Qing's changes were more obvious.
The body that was originally thin has now become strong and strong.
His temperament is also more confident and high-spirited, looking forward to the radiance, like the newborn sun, radiant, but just standing there, there is a soul-stirring sense of oppression.
This is a normal change for a breakthrough in cultivation. Even if he restrains himself slightly in front of his parents, it still makes Su Laoshi and Wang Huilan a little strange.
Su Laoshi patted him from shoulder to chest, compared his height, and finally said with satisfaction:
"This feeling is almost the same as that of your second uncle!"
"I'm still far behind the second uncle. He's already a D-level warrior, and I'm just an E." Su Qing said modestly.
"That is, your second uncle has been struggling for so many years, and you can't compare with him now. It's good to have an E at your age. No, what are you talking about? Son, are you an E-level warrior?"
Su Laoshi's voice was trembling, his eyes were straight, and he couldn't believe it.
These days, he often searches for information about the martial arts holy fetus.
I know it is a holy place for martial arts practice.
Every martial artist and creative martial artist can make great progress there.
I didn’t expect that my son would make such great progress!
Is this E?
"He is an E-level warrior. Has his energy been restored and his lifespan increased?"
Wang Huilan asked eagerly. Others only care about the level of a warrior, whether they are strong or not, and whether their status is high.
As a mother, especially one who has worried about her son's short life for many years, she only cares about whether her son lives long or not.
"I've made up for it, I can live another seventy or eighty years no problem!" Su Qing understood her worries, hugged her, and comforted her softly.
"In more than seventy or eighty years, you can still create martial arts and practice martial arts. You will have no problem living for hundreds or thousands of years in the future!"
Su Laoshi touched his eyes and said with a smile.
Su Qing knew that it was not difficult for a warrior to live for more than a hundred years, but it was not easy for a warrior to continue to increase his lifespan.
As far as he knew, there was no record of a thousand-year-old man on Sky Blue Star, and the oldest Martial Saint was only about 800 years old.
But he just smiled slightly at Su Lao's honest words and did not refute.
After sharing with his family his training experience in the womb of the martial arts saint.
Su Laoshi and Wang Huilan, who had treated him as a treasure just now, complained that he didn't treat Tieniu as a human being.
On the other hand, the third aunt Wang Qiaolan understood clearly. Although she also felt sorry for her son, she knew better as she had experienced the pain of losing her husband.
People who practice martial arts in the womb of the Holy Spirit cannot die. Only if they don't have real skills in the real world will things go wrong.
“If you don’t fight, you won’t be effective, and if you don’t practice, you won’t be successful.
I know Tieniu's savvy. He was able to enter the No. 1 High School because his brother-in-law got in through connections.
If it weren't for Xiao Qing, he wouldn't even be able to enter the martial arts academy, let alone become an E-level warrior! "
Wang Qiaolan talked to Su Laoshi and his wife, and told Tieniu to follow Su Qing well in the future.
Tieniu felt calloused by these words, but he still listened patiently and nodded in agreement.
After talking about their experiences in the martial arts holy womb.
Su Laoshi talked to the two of them about the actual situation.
Su Qing listened to him and picked up her mobile phone to search for news online.
In the days of martial arts saints, this was completely out of touch with the real society.
